rows.label: YouTube
rows.description: American video-sharing platform owned by Alphabet Inc.
rows.hook: lets anyone upload clips and is home to countless viral videos and creators

rows.label: Facebook
rows.description: American online social media and social networking service
rows.hook: connects billions of people through friend lists, walls and a thumbs-up button

rows.label: Taj Mahal
rows.description: marble mausoleum in Agra, India
rows.hook: was built by an emperor as a tomb for his beloved wife

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.description: monument in New York
rows.hook: was a gift from France and welcomes ships into New York Harbor with a torch held high

rows.label: Chocolate
rows.description: nutritionally dense or sweet food product from the seed of Theobroma cacao - cocoa bean
rows.hook: is made from cacao beans and comes in bars, truffles and hot drinks

rows.label: Mars
rows.description: fourth planet from the Solar System, tellurian and orange-red due to iron oxide
rows.hook: is a dusty neighbour planet that rovers explore for signs of ancient water and life

rows.label: Shrek
rows.description: 2001 American film directed by Andrew Adamson and Vicky Jenson
rows.hook: follows a grumpy ogre who rescues a princess with help from a talking donkey

rows.label: Polar bear
rows.description: species of bear native largely within the Arctic Circle
rows.hook: is a huge Arctic predator that hunts seals on drifting sea ice

rows.label: Neptune
rows.description: eighth and farthest planet from the Sun in the Solar System, mainly composed of ice and rock
rows.hook: is the farthest planet from the Sun, known for supersonic winds and the moon Triton

rows.label: Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.description: Sega video game franchise
rows.hook: stars a speedy mascot who collects rings and races past Dr. Eggman

rows.label: Matcha
rows.description: finely powdered green tea
rows.hook: is whisked into a frothy drink and used in Japanese tea ceremonies

rows.label: Banana
rows.description: elongated, edible fruit produced by several kinds of large herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa
rows.hook: is a peeled-by-hand fruit that monkeys are famous for munching and people slip on in cartoons

rows.label: Golden Gate Bridge
rows.description: suspension bridge on the San Francisco Bay
rows.hook: is a famous suspension span across the entrance to San Francisco Bay, often shrouded in fog

rows.label: Corn
rows.description: species of grass cultivated as a food crop
rows.hook: grows on a cob and is popped into a movie-theater snack

rows.label: Avocado
rows.description: species of plant, use Q961769 for the fruit
rows.hook: is mashed into guacamole and spread on toast

rows.label: Ferrari
rows.description: Italian luxury sports car manufacturer
rows.hook: is an Italian maker of racing and luxury sports cars with a prancing horse badge

rows.label: Tomato
rows.description: type of plant species with edible, often red, berry fruit
rows.hook: is technically a fruit but is treated as a vegetable, and tops pizzas and ketchup

rows.label: Pikachu
rows.description: Pokémon species, mascot of the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: is an electric-mouse mascot who says its own name and evolves from Pichu

rows.label: Pac-Man
rows.description: 1980 arcade game developed by Namco
rows.hook: is an arcade game about a hungry circle eating dots while chased by ghosts

rows.label: Garfield
rows.description: comic strip created by Jim Davis
rows.hook: is a lasagna-loving, Monday-hating cat who torments his owner and a dog named Odie

rows.label: Lemon
rows.description: nothospecies of plant
rows.hook: is a sour citrus squeezed into drinks, with a famous saying about life handing it out

rows.label: Sulfur
rows.description: chemical element with symbol S and atomic number 16
rows.hook: is a brimstone element that gives rotten eggs and matches their smell

rows.label: Santa Claus
rows.description: legendary figure said to deliver gifts to people on Christmas Eve
rows.hook: is a jolly gift-bringer who lives at the North Pole and rides a sleigh pulled by reindeer

rows.label: Sapphire
rows.description: gem variety of corundum
rows.hook: is a precious stone that has been set in royal engagement rings

rows.label: SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.description: main character from the animated television show SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.hook: is a cheerful fry cook living in a pineapple under the sea

rows.label: Pumpkin
rows.description: orange (yellow, green) winter squash native to North America
rows.hook: is carved into a lantern at Halloween and baked into a Thanksgiving pie

rows.label: Eggplant
rows.description: species of plant
rows.hook: is a glossy, oval vegetable baked into parmesan dishes and used in ratatouille

rows.label: Strawberry
rows.description: hybrid species in the rose family
rows.hook: is a juicy berry with seeds on the outside, served with cream at Wimbledon

rows.label: Amethyst
rows.description: mineral of quartz variety
rows.hook: is a quartz gemstone and the traditional birthstone for February

rows.label: Crow
rows.description: bird of the genus Corvus, or more broadly a synonym for all of Corvus
rows.hook: is a clever, noisy bird known for solving puzzles and cawing from fields and fence posts

rows.label: Bart Simpson
rows.description: fictional character from The Simpsons
rows.hook: is a prankster who skateboards, shouts catchphrases and constantly infuriates his dad

rows.label: Wasabi
rows.description: species of edible plant
rows.hook: is a pungent paste served with sushi that clears your sinuses

rows.label: Broccoli
rows.description: edible green plant in the cabbage family
rows.hook: is a tiny-tree vegetable that many children refuse to eat

rows.label: Tweety
rows.description: Warner Bros. theatrical cartoon character
rows.hook: is a canary who keeps being chased by a cat who thinks he saw a puddy tat

rows.label: Milk
rows.description: white liquid produced by the mammary glands of mammals
rows.hook: comes from cows and is poured over cereal

rows.label: Flamingo
rows.description: family of birds
rows.hook: is a long-legged wading bird that famously rests standing on one leg

rows.label: Raven
rows.description: common name of several of the larger birds of the genus Corvus
rows.hook: is a large, glossy, intelligent bird in a famous Edgar Allan Poe poem

rows.label: Northern cardinal
rows.description: species of bird
rows.hook: is a crested songbird that is the state bird of many US states

rows.label: Salt
rows.description: mineral used as food ingredient, composed primarily of sodium chloride
rows.hook: is a mineral seasoning shaken onto food and spread on icy roads

rows.label: Hemoglobin
rows.description: oxygen-transport metalloprotein in red blood cells of most vertebrates
rows.hook: is the iron-rich protein that carries oxygen around the body

rows.label: Coal
rows.description: combustible sedimentary rock composed primarily of carbon
rows.hook: is a fossil fuel burned for power and left as a lump in naughty stockings

rows.label: Blood
rows.description: organic fluid which transports nutrients throughout the organism
rows.hook: is pumped by the heart through veins and is given at donation drives

rows.label: Carrot
rows.description: taproot of the domesticated carrot plant
rows.hook: is a crunchy root vegetable that rabbits are famous for munching, said to help eyesight

rows.label: Eeyore
rows.description: character from Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh-books
rows.hook: is a gloomy stuffed donkey who loses his tail in the Hundred Acre Wood

rows.label: Elmo
rows.description: Muppet character on the children's television show Sesame Street
rows.hook: is a furry, giggling monster who refers to himself in the third person on a children's street

rows.label: Yoda
rows.description: fictional character from Star Wars
rows.hook: is a tiny, wise Jedi master who speaks in backwards sentences

rows.label: Emerald
rows.description: green gemstone, a beryl variety
rows.hook: is a precious beryl gem and the birthstone for May, also the name of a famous fictional city in Oz

rows.label: Mustard
rows.description: condiment made from various varieties of mustard seeds
rows.hook: is a tangy condiment squirted on hot dogs and pretzels

rows.label: Ruby
rows.description: variety of corundum, mineral, gemstone
rows.hook: is a precious corundum gem and the birthstone for July

rows.label: Bulbasaur
rows.description: Pokémon species
rows.hook: is the first creature in the original Pokedex, carrying a plant bulb on its back

rows.label: Cranberry
rows.description: fruit, subgenus of plant
rows.hook: is a tart berry boiled into a Thanksgiving sauce and juiced into a popular drink

rows.label: Kermit the Frog
rows.description: Muppet character
rows.hook: is a puppet amphibian who sings that it is not easy being what he is, and hosts a famous variety show

rows.label: Patrick Star
rows.description: main character in SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.hook: is a dim-witted best friend who lives under a rock in Bikini Bottom

rows.label: Cloud
rows.description: visible mass of liquid droplets or frozen crystals suspended in the atmosphere
rows.hook: is a floating mass of vapor that brings rain, shade and shapes people imagine

rows.label: Poppy
rows.description: common name for various plant species of the family Papaveraceae
rows.hook: is a flower worn on Remembrance Day to honor fallen soldiers and source of opium

rows.label: Pea
rows.description: species of plant with edible seeds
rows.hook: is a small round seed that comes in a pod and is famously princess-bothering in a fairy tale

rows.label: Kirby
rows.description: fictional character
rows.hook: is a round, puffy hero who inhales enemies to copy their abilities

rows.label: Gumby
rows.description: 1957 American clay animation franchise
rows.hook: is a bendy clay character who jumps into books and is accompanied by a horse named Pokey

rows.label: Chlorophyll
rows.description: group of chemical compounds
rows.hook: is the pigment that lets plants turn sunlight into food

rows.label: Grass
rows.description: collective name for three families of plants
rows.hook: is a lawn plant that is mowed on Saturday mornings and eaten by cattle

rows.label: Mozzarella
rows.description: Italian cheese
rows.hook: is a stretchy cheese on pizza and in caprese salad

rows.label: Spinach
rows.description: species of plant
rows.hook: is a leafy vegetable that gives a sailor man superhuman strength

rows.label: Lime
rows.description: green and acidic citrus fruit of various Citrus species
rows.hook: is a sour citrus wedge squeezed into a gin and tonic or stuck in a Corona bottle

rows.label: Mute swan
rows.description: species of swan
rows.hook: is a graceful water bird that mates for life and stars in a famous ballet

rows.label: Yoshi
rows.description: fictonal character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is a dinosaur companion who flutters, gobbles enemies with a long tongue and carries a plumber

rows.label: Chalk
rows.description: soft, white, porous sedimentary rock
rows.hook: is a soft rock used on blackboards and sidewalk drawings

rows.label: Canary
rows.description: breed of domesticated bird
rows.hook: is a songbird that miners once took underground to detect poison gas

rows.label: Big Bird
rows.description: Sesame Street character
rows.hook: is an eight-foot-tall feathered resident of Sesame Street with a snuffleupagus friend

rows.label: Snow
rows.description: precipitation in the form of ice crystal flakes
rows.hook: falls in flakes that build snowmen and close schools

rows.label: Grinch
rows.description: fictional character created by Dr. Seuss
rows.hook: is a grumpy hermit who steals Christmas from the Whos in Whoville

rows.label: TARDIS
rows.description: fictional time-travelling device
rows.hook: is a time machine that looks like a British police call box and is bigger on the inside

rows.label: School bus
rows.description: bus operated by a school or school district for student transport
rows.hook: carries kids to class and flashes lights with a stop sign
